title: fumaria muralis proles vagans
intro: Fumaria muralis proles vagans, commonly known as Fumaria, is a species of flowering plant in the fumitory family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-asthmatic, and diuretic, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and reducing fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Fumaria include alkaloids, such as fumaric acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and are being researched for their potential in treating conditions such as psoriasis and multiple sclerosis.
